payload.title: File:Eunotosaurus Illust by Gabriel Ugueto.png
payload.credit_html: I commissioned the artist, Gabriel Ugueto, to create this artwork of Eunotosaurus for our paper on turtle origins, and am choosing to make it accessible here.
payload.description_html: Parting the middle Permian undergrowth: paleoartistic reconstruction of a pair of the millerettid stem-reptile Eunotosaurus africanus by Gabriel Ugueto.
